statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41579 affects runc root filesystem setup when a container runtime initializes /dev symlinks for an untrusted container image. The virt-operator image ships the virt-operator application binary, not a container runtime entrypoint, and it does not execute runc rootfs setup paths. The runc package is linked transitively through KubeVirt libraries; the vulnerable container runtime setup code path is not reachable from virt-operator. Updating KubeVirt 1.8.2 to runc 1.3.6 is not currently build-compatible because that runc line no longer provides the libcontainer/cgroups packages imported by KubeVirt 1.8.2.

CVE-2026-41579 affects runc root filesystem setup when a container runtime initializes /dev symlinks for an untrusted container image. virt-handler uses runc's libcontainer/cgroups helper packages for cgroup management, but it is not a container runtime entrypoint and does not execute the rootfs setup path where the symlink-following flaw occurs. Updating KubeVirt 1.8.2 to runc 1.3.6 is not currently build-compatible because that runc line no longer provides the libcontainer/cgroups packages imported by KubeVirt 1.8.2.
